audit_items.proof_trace: Both `is_used` (L243) and `expires_at` (L246) are checked server-side in `completeRegistration` using the admin client before any card registration completes, and `is_used: true` is set afterwards (L267). The alternative `completeTempRegistration` function in `registration.service.ts` (which lacks these checks) is not called anywhere in production. RLS on `attendance.users` restricts writes to service_role only, preventing direct Supabase API bypass.
